journey.title: Your journey with Nadoumi
journey.description: From your first application fee to your admission documents — here is what to expect.
journey.s1b: Start your application and settle the application fee to begin processing.
journey.s2b: Nadoumi checks your profile and documents against the opportunity’s requirements.
journey.s3b: Your case is matched and submitted to the university.
journey.s4b: The university confirms your place and issues your admission letter.
journey.s5b: Settle the remaining project and service fees to move to enrolment.
journey.s6b: Your visa documentation (JW202 / JW201) is prepared and released.
journey.s7b: Your admission and visa documents are couriered to you.
journey.s8b: You’re ready to travel and enrol. Nadoumi stays available through arrival.

about.title: The team that runs your study-abroad journey
about.lead: Nadoumi is an international education platform. We help students discover universities and scholarships, and we manage the application process end to end.
about.whoBody: Nadoumi connects students with universities, programmes and scholarships across China, Malaysia and other destinations, and supports them through the whole application lifecycle — profile, documents, submission, decisions and enrolment.
about.whoBody2: An account holder can manage applications for more than one student, so parents, relatives and advisers can work alongside the student they support.
about.missionBody: Make international study accessible: help students find opportunities that fit, and carry the operational load of applying so they can focus on their studies.
about.visionBody: A single trusted place where any student can discover, apply for and track an international education — with universities and partners on the other side of the same platform.
about.v1b: Students see the information that matters to them. Internal partner and operational data never leaks into public views.
about.v2b: An application is a record of what was submitted, when. Later profile edits never rewrite a past submission.
about.v3b: Numbers, universities, scholarships and rankings are shown only when they come from real records — never mocked to fill space.
about.v4b: Enter your details once. Nadoumi reuses them across every application and keeps you in control of them.
about.h1: Build a reusable applicant profile with your details, education and documents.
about.h2: Discover universities, programmes and scholarships that fit your goals.
about.h3: Apply for yourself or a student you represent — Nadoumi pre-fills what it knows.
about.h4: Provide and track the documents each opportunity requires.
about.h5: Receive decisions, complete payments and prepare for enrolment.

legal.privacyIntro: This page explains what personal data Nadoumi collects and how it is used.
legal.privacyBody: Nadoumi processes the information you provide to build your applicant profile and submit applications on your behalf. Data is stored securely and shared only with the universities and partners involved in your applications.
legal.termsIntro: These terms govern your use of the Nadoumi platform.
legal.termsBody: By creating an account you agree to provide accurate information and to use the platform only for legitimate education applications. Nadoumi may update these terms; material changes will be notified.
